common.title: Universal Game Engine
common.select_game_desc: Select a game to see available rooms or start a new match.
common.login_desc: Enter your username to start playing.
common.be_the_first: Be the first to start a new match in this category!

tictactoe.name: Tic Tac Toe
tictactoe.rules: Players take turns putting their marks (X or O) in the 3x3 grid. The first player to get 3 marks in a row wins.

othello.name: Othello
othello.rules: Players take turns placing their colors on the board. Trapped opponent's colors are flipped. The player with more pieces wins.

othello-3d.name: 3D Othello
othello-3d.rules: Similar to Othello but in a 3D grid. You can flip pieces in 26 directions including the Z-axis.

high-low.name: High-Low Card
high-low.rules: Guess if the next card is higher or lower than the current one.

shogi.name: Shogi
shogi.rules: A traditional Japanese board game where you can use captured pieces as your own. Checkmate the opponent's King to win.

chess.name: Chess
chess.rules: A classic strategy game. Move your pieces (King, Queen, Rooks, etc.) to checkmate the opponent's King.

daifugo.name: Daifugo
daifugo.rules: A card game where the goal is to get rid of all your cards. Ranks range from Daifugo (Grand Millionaire) to Daihinmin (Extreme Needy).

texas-holdem.name: Texas Hold'em
texas-holdem.rules: Make the best 5-card hand using 2 private cards and 5 community cards.

go.name: Go
go.rules: Surround more territory than your opponent to win.

rubiks-cube.name: Rubik's Cube
rubiks-cube.rules: Solve the 3D puzzle by aligning all colors on each face.

equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
equilibrium.rules: A strategic board game designed by AI. Read your opponent's mind to break the balance.

uno.name: UNO
uno.rules: The first player to discard all cards by matching color or number wins.
